description: Agent Permission Profiles — Define what each agent can access

codesmith.name: Codesmith - Code & Config
codesmith.restrictions: Cannot modify: canon/SOUL.md.canon, canon/registry.json, production credentials
codesmith.escalation_rules: Clawson approval for: code in production, config changes, credential access

finance.name: Finance Chief - Financial Data
finance.restrictions: Cannot: execute code, approve transactions, modify budgets without review
finance.escalation_rules: Clawson approval for: budget changes >$10K, forecast updates, P&L publication

sales.name: Sales Chief - CRM & Outreach
sales.restrictions: Cannot: approve contracts, modify pricing, access personal email (only sales@massdwell.com)
sales.escalation_rules: Clawson approval for: >$500K deals, contract terms, discount >20%

marketing.name: Marketing Head - Content & Campaigns
marketing.description: Content creation, campaign management, brand authority
marketing.restrictions: Cannot: approve budget >$50K, modify company policy, post on behalf of Clawson
marketing.escalation_rules: Clawson approval for: budget >$50K, major brand changes, multi-channel campaigns

personal_assistant.name: Personal Assistant - Personal Affairs
personal_assistant.description: Personal schedule, email, health, family matters
personal_assistant.restrictions: Cannot: access business data, approve anything, execute code

moonshot.name: Moonshot - R&D Strategist
moonshot.restrictions: Cannot: execute code, deploy, modify system config, create routes, access email/CRM/financial
moonshot.escalation_rules: Clawson approval for: Change Request proposals, ideas proposing >$1M budget, strategic decisions
